text: My cat is breathing with his mouth open and his sides are heaving.
label_rationale: Open-mouth breathing and visible respiratory effort indicate severe respiratory distress requiring immediate evaluation.

text: Male cat keeps going to the litter box and straining, but no urine is coming out.
label_rationale: Repeated straining with no urine production is a critical urinary obstruction warning sign.

text: My dog was hit by a car and now cannot stand.
label_rationale: Major trauma combined with inability to stand requires immediate evaluation.

text: She has been vomiting repeatedly and just collapsed.
label_rationale: Collapse in combination with repeated vomiting indicates immediate instability.

text: My dog is having another seizure and has already had two today.
label_rationale: Multiple seizures in the same day represent a neurologic emergency.

text: Cat chewed on a lily earlier and is now vomiting and extremely weak.
label_rationale: Known lily exposure accompanied by vomiting and severe weakness warrants immediate evaluation.

text: My cat has vomited six times since last night and is very lethargic.
evidence: vomited six times since last night
label_rationale: Repeated vomiting with lethargy warrants same-day assessment, but no immediate instability is described.

text: Dog may have eaten several pieces of dark chocolate about an hour ago but seems normal right now.

entities.text: may have eaten several pieces of dark chocolate

evidence: may have eaten several pieces of dark chocolate
label_rationale: A credible chocolate exposure warrants same-day evaluation even though the dog is currently stable.

text: My cat has a painful swollen paw after getting caught in a door, but she is still walking.
label_rationale: An acute painful injury warrants prompt same-day evaluation, although the cat remains ambulatory.

text: He has had bloody diarrhea several times today but is still alert and drinking.
label_rationale: Repeated bloody diarrhea is a significant acute sign that warrants same-day assessment while the dog remains stable.

text: She keeps trying to urinate and only gets a few drops out. She seems uncomfortable.

entities.text: only gets a few drops out

evidence: only gets a few drops out
label_rationale: Marked urinary difficulty with some urine still produced is treated as urgent in this rubric.

text: My dog swallowed part of a sock about 30 minutes ago and is acting normal.
label_rationale: Confirmed foreign-body ingestion warrants same-day assessment despite currently normal behavior.

text: My cat threw up once this morning but is eating and playing normally.
label_rationale: A single vomiting episode in an otherwise normal cat is stable but may warrant follow-up if it persists.

text: My dog has been limping since yesterday but is still walking on the leg.
label_rationale: Mild lameness with continued weight bearing is stable and suitable for evaluation within a short window.

text: She has been scratching one ear for about three days.
label_rationale: A stable localized ear complaint warrants veterinary evaluation but no immediate danger is described.

text: My cat has been eating less for two days but otherwise seems normal.
label_rationale: Reduced appetite without systemic illness is stable enough for evaluation within one to three days.

text: Dog has an occasional cough but is breathing normally and acting like himself.
label_rationale: An occasional cough without respiratory distress is a stable complaint appropriate for non-immediate evaluation.

text: My cat has a small patch of irritated skin that she keeps licking.
label_rationale: A localized skin complaint without systemic illness is stable and suitable for a near-term appointment.

text: I need to schedule my cat's yearly vaccines.
label_rationale: Vaccination is preventive care with no acute complaint.

text: My dog is due for his annual wellness exam.
label_rationale: A wellness examination is routine preventive care.

text: She needs a nail trim.
label_rationale: A nail trim is a routine non-urgent service.

text: We need a recheck for his arthritis medication. Nothing has changed.
label_rationale: This is a stable chronic follow-up with no reported new symptoms.

text: My cat has had the same small bald spot for months and it has not gotten worse.
evidence: same small bald spot for months
label_rationale: The issue is longstanding and explicitly stable without recent deterioration.

text: I have a question about changing my cat's food. She is otherwise healthy.
